# AIBfamily — family mode for AIBs (in development)
> Parents see what they need. Children keep their privacy. AIBfamily is in development, built on AIB.core, the core of AIBEVA.

## Key facts
- Status: in development, built on AIB.core. Not yet available. No dates announced.
- Our goal: every family member has their own intelligent being, and only what is explicitly allowed is shared.
- Our goal: the Guardian layer (AIBguardian) inside every being; designed around the EU AI Act and GDPR.
- Contact: info@aiblab.info · Support: support@aiblab.info
- Available today: AIBEVA, Level S2, an intelligent being for Windows (for adults, 18+), no ads, no subscription: https://aibeva.com/download
- Operator: SAY TO PAY s.r.o. (AIBlab), Ostrava, Czech Republic, EU · on the market since 2019 · Company ID 086 94 222
